exposure: Prenatal quantitative sensory testing (QST) parameters (mechanical thresholds, thermal thresholds, mechanical tolerances, thermal tolerances, temporal summation)
cohort: The study included 164 healthy primiparous women, with 55 completing labor pain diaries, who were enrolled and followed from the third trimester through delivery.
finding: Prenatal quantitative sensory testing parameters were associated with emotional aspects of labor pain, specifically pain unpleasantness was associated with average heat threshold, post wind-up pain, and post probe pain.
